permutation_floor_greater_equal.note: Equivalent relabelings leave D unchanged, so P(lambda* >= lambda_obs) cannot fall below the multiplicity of the observed RDM if that structure is uniquely best.

demeaned_gram_extra.note_rdm_corr: rdm_corr_window is Pearson of unique i<j entries of the theoretical RDM vs ||u_i-u_j||^2 on the analysis-window component traces (demeaned iff demean_time). rdm_corr_full_epoch uses the same spatial filter on the whole epoch. Paper face 0.82 / car >0.99 are not tuning targets.
